---
name: Report a data issue
about: Report a problem in the Wildland Almanac data so it can be considered for the next revision
title: "[DATA ISSUE] "
labels: ["data-issue", "for-next-revision"]
---

<!--
Thank you for helping improve the Wildland Almanac.

Please read first:
• Reports are reviewed and incorporated into the next scheduled revision,
  released every 6–12 months. They are NOT fixed individually or in real time.
• We read every report but cannot respond individually or provide project
  or analysis support.
• The more specific your report, the more usable it is. Please fill in the
  prompts below as completely as you can.
-->

### What are you seeing?
<!-- Describe what looks wrong, as concretely as possible. -->


### Which properties / layers?
<!-- One or several. Name the property/properties involved (e.g., tree cover fraction, canopy height, flame length). It's fine if the problem spans multiple layers. -->


### Where?
<!-- Location of the problem: coordinates, a place name, a tile or region. The more precise, the better. -->


### When?
<!-- Which water year(s)? If you can, name the specific data file(s) / tile(s) you were looking at (e.g., the COG filename or STAC item ID). -->


### Why do you think it's off?
<!-- Your reasoning — what makes you think this is wrong rather than expected. -->


### Is this ground truth, or a systematic pattern?
<!-- This is the most useful thing you can tell us. Check one:
[ ] I have specific local or field knowledge of THIS site that could serve as ground truth (please describe it).
[ ] I'm reporting a broader pattern or apparent artifact that seems to recur across areas or time (please describe its extent).
-->


### Anything else / screenshots
<!-- Optional. Attach a screenshot or add any other context. -->
